# quickvansend

Sends a file with the Quick-VAN protocol.

```ttl
quickvansend <filename>
```

## Remarks

Causes Tera Term to send the file &lt;filename&gt; to the host with the Quick-VAN protocol.
Pauses until the end of the file transfer.
If the file is transferred successfully, the system variable "result" is set to 1. Otherwise, "result" is set to zero.

When &lt;filename&gt; is relative path, file is saved relative to [file transfer folder](https://teratermproject.github.io/manual/5/en/html/setup/folder.html#filedir).

## Example

```ttl
quickvansend 'readme.txt'
```
